Chapter 7: Silver Horizon

The scout vessel emerged from hyperspace just above the rings of the fourth gas giant.

On the forward deck, Commander Lin watched the sensor array paint the orbital dock in pale green lines.

"All stations report normal pressure," the helmsman announced, easing the thrusters into docking alignment.

Lin nodded once and reached for the encrypted comm channel that linked the outpost to the home fleet.
